concessions.summary: The full bar and concessions are cashless, and you must be 21+ with valid ID to buy alcohol. Outside food and beverages aren't allowed.

accessibility.summary: The Union is mostly general admission standing room, with an accessible area in the GA setup that is first come, first served, so arrive early. ADA tickets and documentation aren't required, and any staff member can direct you to the ADA section. Each ADA guest may bring one companion and must stay seated in the section.
